title: Tyson Fury Discusses Personal Challenges in New Netflix Documentary
excerpt:
A new documentary follows Tyson Fury's career and personal challenges.
The 90-minute Netflix film premieres on November 27, 2026.
body_md:
Netflix is releasing a new feature-length documentary about British heavyweight boxing star Tyson Fury. The production follows his career from childhood to international recognition, exploring both major sporting victories and the personal challenges he has encountered along the way. It is intended as a broader portrait of the athlete rather than simply a preview of his next fight.

The film includes Fury's own reflections on his well-being and the difficult period that followed his landmark victory over Wladimir Klitschko in 2015. He also discusses experiences from 2017, when his life and career were undergoing significant changes. The documentary presents these experiences as personal testimony, allowing viewers to hear how Fury understands the events in retrospect.

One of the turning points described in the film occurred on Halloween in 2017. Fury recalls attending an event and recognizing that his circumstances had changed considerably from his championship days. He describes this as a moment when he realized he needed support and began considering how to rebuild his life. The film connects that decision with his eventual return to professional boxing.

Members of his family also participate. His wife, Paris Fury, and father, John Fury, offer perspectives on the challenges they witnessed and the difficulties of understanding what a loved one is experiencing. Their contributions add a family dimension to the familiar narrative of a champion's career and help explain why the project goes beyond a conventional sports documentary.

Lucy Wilcox directs the 90-minute film, produced by Optomen, a company within Banijay. George Waldrum is the executive producer. The documentary is expected to cover Fury's early years, rise to fame, setbacks and subsequent comeback, bringing together career milestones and personal reflections in one chronological account.

Tyson Fury is scheduled to arrive on Netflix on November 27, 2026. Its release comes approximately two weeks before the platform's planned live broadcast of a boxing match between Fury and Anthony Joshua. Although the timing places the documentary close to another major sporting event, its announced focus is the wider story of Fury's life and experiences.

The finished film will determine how much detail viewers receive about the experiences described in advance. For now, the confirmed information includes its release date, runtime, production team and participation from Fury's family. The project offers audiences an opportunity to see a different side of one of Britain's most recognizable sports personalities.
